# Rule 7 — Self-Antagonism. Performing actions characteristic of antagonists without having the corresponding role is prohibited. Freeing someone from the brig without cause, interfering with Security's work, and similar conduct violate this rule. Claims that your character is "unstable," "psychotic," or anything similar do not override any rule and are not a justification.
